test_title: PYST 54: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following types of unemployment is found in India when people are employed for a certain period of a year in tourist resorts and various tourism-related activities in the mountain regions, but are unemployed in off-seasons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seasonal unemployment**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Seasonal unemployment is the type of unemployment that occurs when people are employed for a certain period of the year but are unemployed during other times.
 
• This is the type of unemployment that occurs in India when people are employed in the tourism sector but are unemployed during the off-season. 
 
• Seasonal unemployment is common in industries and occupations that are subject to seasonal demand or weather, such as tourism, farming, and construction.
 
• In the tourism sector, some months of the year have more tourists than others, which can lead to seasonal unemployment. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other types of unemployment include:
 
• Frictional unemployment: Occurs when someone is unemployed by choice while looking for a better job opportunity. 
 
• Underemployment
 
 
• When people are employed but want or are available to work more hours.
 
• This can include part-time workers who want to work full-time or people who usually work full-time but are currently working part-time. 
 
 
 
• Disguised unemployment
 
 
• When people are employed but not to their full potential due to a lack of opportunities.
 
• This can include people who are working below their skill set, or people who are doing part-time work but want to work full-time.
 
• Disguised unemployment is also known as underemployment
 
 
 
• Cyclical unemployment is a type of unemployment that occurs when the economy changes, such as during a recession or period of economic growth.
 
 
• It's characterized by a short-term increase in unemployment, usually lasting from one month to 1.5 years.
